info.description:
*Last updated: August 20, 2026*
IonQ's API for accessing the IonQ Quantum Cloud platform

Please subscribe for automated updates when we perform maintenance or
experience an outage.

In addition, you may use the [status endpoint](#tag/status) to check the
current status of our API.

## Authentication

<SecurityDefinitions />
info.title: IonQ Cloud Platform API

get.description: Retrieves current key associated with this session.
This endpoint retrieves an array of all available backend characterizations, with pagination.

parameters.description: Characterizations starting at this time (e.g., `start=2025-12-31`)
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: Characterizations before this time (e.g., `end=2025-12-31`)
parameters.name: end

parameters.description: How many objects to return.
parameters.name: limit

400.description: Bad Request. A multi-circuit job may contain at most 5,000 circuits and 150,000 gates in total across them; validation cost scales with gate count, so a job can exceed the gate limit while staying under both the circuit count and the body size

413.description: Request Entity Too Large. The request body may not exceed 10MB

429.description: Too Many Requests. To get a higher rate limit, please reach out to support@ionq.co

500.description: A generic server failure, please reach out to support@ionq.co for help with this error

502.description: Bad Gateway, this can be caused by misbehaving proxies, or by service issues. These can be retried, and downtime can be found on status.ionq.co

503.description: Service Unavailable, this is indicative of service outage, please check status.ionq.co

kw.description: The amount of energy used by the backend in kilowatt-hours.

supported_error_mitigations.description: Error mitigation options supported by the backend.

supported_native_gates.description: Native gates supported by the backend.

connectivity.description: An array of valid, unordered tuples of possible qubits for executing two-qubit gates (e.g., `[[0, 1], [0, 2], [1, 2]]`)

date.description: Date time of the measurement, in ISO format.

fidelity.description:
Fidelity for single-qubit (`1q`) and two-qubit (`2q`) gates, and State Preparation and Measurement (`spam`) operations.
Currently provides only median fidelity; additional statistical data will be added in the future.

timing.description: Time, in seconds, of various system properties: `t1` time, `t2` time, `1q` gate time, `2q` gate time, `readout` time, and qubit `reset` time.

pagination-next.description: ID of next batch of resources to load.

pagination-page.description: Specify the page of results to return.

targets.description: The qubits that a quantum gate is applied to

controls.description: The qubits that determine whether the operation is applied to targets.

angle.description: Interaction angle for ms gate (in turns, default 0.25)

Qasm3CircuitInput.title: QASM3 Circuit
Qasm3CircuitInput.description: Submit an OpenQASM 3 program with `type: ionq.qasm3.v1`. `data` carries the program source as a single string. IonQ accepts a subset of the language — see the [OpenQASM 3](/api-reference/v0.4/openqasm3) page.

CircuitJobInput.description:
Every input shape a single-circuit job can carry. QIS and native circuits
are JSON gate lists; `ionq.qasm3.v1` carries the program source instead.
The `type` discriminator selects which one applies — see the per-option
docs below.

shots.description: `shots` is ignored by ideal simulator backend.

error_mitigation.description: To turn on debiasing, you must request at least 500 shots

input.description:
The circuit to run. `ionq.circuit.v1` takes a JSON gate list (`qubits`,
`gateset`, `circuit`); `ionq.qasm3.v1` takes the OpenQASM 3 program
source in `input.data`.

circuit.description: Circuit gates. Can be either QIS gates or Native gates depending on the gateset property.

registers.description: Registers to use in your circuit. Each register is a list of qubit indices (starting from zero).

gateset.description:
Optional gateset override for this individual circuit. If not specified, inherits from parent.
When set, the circuit must use the appropriate gate format (QIS).

circuit.description: Circuit gates. Can be either QIS gates or Native gates depending on the gateset property.

registers.description: Registers to use in your circuit. Each register is a list of qubit indices (starting from zero).

gateset.description:
Optional gateset override for this individual circuit. If not specified, inherits from parent.
When set, the circuit must use the appropriate gate format (Native).

circuits.description:
Every circuit in the job. Passing a singular `input.circuit` alongside
this field is rejected rather than ignored. A single job accepts up to
5,000 circuits and 150,000 gates in total across them.

shots.description: `shots` is ignored by ideal simulator backend.

error_mitigation.description: To turn on debiasing, you must request at least 500 shots

input.description:
Submit multiple circuits in a single job. Each circuit inherits the parent
`input.gateset` unless overridden by `circuits[].gateset`.

MultiCircuitJobCreationPayload.title: JSON Multi Circuit Job
MultiCircuitJobCreationPayload.description: Submit multiple circuits in a single job. Each circuit inherits the parent `input.gateset` unless overridden by `circuits[].gateset`. You can submit up to 5,000 circuits in a single multi-circuit job, totalling at most 150,000 gates across them.

shots.description: `shots` is ignored by ideal simulator backend.

ApiCostModel.description:
The billing model used for this job. `QCT` for jobs billed on quantum
compute time, `2QGE_operations` for jobs billed on two-qubit gate operations.

submitter_id.description: The id of the user who submitted the job.

execution_duration_ms.description: How long the job actually took to run on the QPU. Null if the job hasn't run yet.

shots.description: `shots` are not included with ideal simulator backend.

noise.description: Only present in the response when `backend` is simulator.

cost_model.description: The billing model used for this job.

stats.description: Job-type-specific execution statistics. The concrete shape is determined by the job type (see the per-job-type tabs above).

results.description: Job-type-specific results. The concrete shape is determined by the job type — see the per-job-type tabs above.

jobs.description: List of jobs. Common fields are shown below; each entry's full per-type shape (with `settings`, `stats`, `output`, `results` documented by job type) is available on the [Get Job](/api-reference/v0.4/jobs/get-job) page.

target.description: Filter jobs by backend target. Supports single target or comma-separated list of targets.

submitter_id.description: The id of another user within a shared project to view their submitted jobs. Ignored if not a project member.

ArtifactDescriptor.description:
Artifact descriptor. Pass `id` to `GET /v0.4/jobs/{id}/artifacts/{artifactId}` to
download the artifact payload, then validate it against the JSON Schema for its format.

id.description: Artifact ID used to download via the artifacts endpoint.

format.description: Format identifier. Fetch the payload schema from the matching schema-catalog endpoint.

CompiledCircuits.description:
Map of compiled-circuit artifacts keyed by circuit format identifier
(e.g. `ionq.native.v1`). See the [Circuit formats](/api-reference/v0.4/schemas/circuit-formats) page for the catalog of valid identifiers.

VariantResults.description:
Per-variant results object. Each entry is keyed by an artifact format
identifier; pass the descriptor's `id` to `GET /v0.4/jobs/{id}/artifacts/{artifactId}`
to download the payload, then validate it against the JSON Schema for its format.
See the [Results formats](/api-reference/v0.4/schemas/results-formats) page for
the catalog of valid identifiers.

CircuitJobResults.description:
Results object for circuit-family jobs (single-circuit, qasm, qasm3, qir, qaoa-circuit).
Each entry is keyed by an artifact format identifier. See the [Results formats](/api-reference/v0.4/schemas/results-formats) page for the catalog of valid identifiers.

SingleCircuitJob.description:
Response shape for single-circuit jobs.

Covers every circuit-shaped job type: user-submitted (`ionq.circuit.v1`,
`ionq.qasm3.v1`, `ionq.qir.v1`) and the per-circuit child jobs spawned by a QAOA run
(`qctrl.qaoa-circuit.v1`). They all share the same settings, stats, output,
and results shape — only the `type` discriminator differs.

submitter_id.description: The id of the user who submitted the job.

execution_duration_ms.description: How long the job actually took to run on the QPU. Null if the job hasn't run yet.

shots.description: `shots` are not included with ideal simulator backend.

noise.description: Only present in the response when `backend` is simulator.

cost_model.description: The billing model used for this job.

stats.description: Job-type-specific execution statistics. The concrete shape is determined by the job type (see the per-job-type tabs above).

results.description: Result artifacts produced by the circuit, keyed by format identifier. Each entry is an `ArtifactDescriptor` — pass its `id` to the [artifact endpoint](/api-reference/v0.4/jobs/get-job-artifact) to download the payload. See [Results formats](/api-reference/v0.4/schemas/results-formats) for the catalog of valid identifiers and their payload schemas.

MultiCircuitJobResults.description:
Results object for ionq.multi-circuit.v1 jobs. Keyed by artifact format identifier;
`ionq.result.probabilities-aggregate.json.v1` is the aggregated distribution across all circuits. See the [Results formats](/api-reference/v0.4/schemas/results-formats) page for the full list of valid identifiers.

MultiCircuitJob.description:
Response shape for `ionq.multi-circuit.v1` jobs. Aggregates results across
the per-circuit child jobs into a single results object keyed by format
identifier (typically `ionq.result.probabilities-aggregate.json.v1`).

submitter_id.description: The id of the user who submitted the job.

execution_duration_ms.description: How long the job actually took to run on the QPU. Null if the job hasn't run yet.

shots.description: `shots` are not included with ideal simulator backend.

noise.description: Only present in the response when `backend` is simulator.

cost_model.description: The billing model used for this job.

stats.description: Job-type-specific execution statistics. The concrete shape is determined by the job type (see the per-job-type tabs above).

results.description: Aggregated result artifacts across all child circuits, keyed by format identifier. Typically contains `ionq.result.probabilities-aggregate.json.v1` — the merged probability distribution over every child circuit. Each entry is an `ArtifactDescriptor` — pass its `id` to the [artifact endpoint](/api-reference/v0.4/jobs/get-job-artifact) to download the payload. See [Results formats](/api-reference/v0.4/schemas/results-formats) for the catalog of valid identifiers and their payload schemas.

QuantumFunctionJobOutput.description: Output for quantum-function jobs. Shape varies by function implementation.

QaoaResults.description: Optimization output recorded by a Q-CTRL QAOA job after it completes.

optimal_cost.description: Best objective value the optimizer reached.

optimal_bitstring.description: Bitstring corresponding to the best solution found.

processing_status.description: Current state of the optimization loop.

QuantumFunctionJobSettings.description:
Settings for quantum-function-family jobs (`qctrl.qaoa.v1`, `quantum-function`).
Unlike circuit jobs, no compilation settings are accepted — only error mitigation.

QuantumFunctionJobStats.description: Stats for quantum-function jobs. Shape varies by function implementation.

QaoaJob.description:
Response shape for `qctrl.qaoa.v1` jobs — the parent QAOA optimization job.
Its per-iteration child jobs (`qctrl.qaoa-circuit.v1`) are surfaced via
`child_job_ids` and are documented under the Single Circuit tab.

submitter_id.description: The id of the user who submitted the job.

execution_duration_ms.description: How long the job actually took to run on the QPU. Null if the job hasn't run yet.

shots.description: `shots` are not included with ideal simulator backend.

noise.description: Only present in the response when `backend` is simulator.

cost_model.description: The billing model used for this job.

stats.description: Job-type-specific execution statistics. The concrete shape is determined by the job type (see the per-job-type tabs above).

results.description: Optimization results emitted by the QAOA solver — the best objective value, the corresponding bitstring, and the current state of the optimization loop. Populated once `processing_status` is `complete`.

QuantumFunctionJobResults.description:
Results for quantum-function jobs — a scalar estimator output (`value`) and
its estimated variance across the shot ensemble (`variance`).

value.description: Scalar value produced by the function — typically the expectation value of the observable.

variance.description: Estimated variance of `value` across the shot ensemble.

QuantumFunctionJob.description:
Response shape for `quantum-function` jobs. Settings, stats, output, and
results are all free-form — the concrete shape is defined by the function
implementation and varies by provider.

submitter_id.description: The id of the user who submitted the job.

execution_duration_ms.description: How long the job actually took to run on the QPU. Null if the job hasn't run yet.

shots.description: `shots` are not included with ideal simulator backend.

noise.description: Only present in the response when `backend` is simulator.

cost_model.description: The billing model used for this job.

stats.description: Job-type-specific execution statistics. The concrete shape is determined by the job type (see the per-job-type tabs above).

results.description: Scalar metrics emitted by the quantum-function implementation — the expectation value of the observable (`value`) and its estimated variance across the shot ensemble (`variance`).

GetJobResponse.description:
Discriminated union over the four job-type families. Tabs in the docs are
grouped by these families (matching the `JobCreationPayload` grouping on the
Create Job endpoint).

unit.description: The currency code the cost is denominated in. `credit` is used instead for organizations billed in Credits.
The currency code the cost is denominated in. `credit` is used instead for organizations billed in Credits.

job_cost_minimum.description: Present only when unit is "gates" and the contract applies a job minimum.

estimated_execution_time.description: Predicted job execution time, in milliseconds.

estimated_quantum_compute_time_us.description:
Predicted quantum compute time, in microseconds. Only present for
compute_second priced backends.

current_predicted_queue_time.description: Predicted time this job will wait in the queue before running, in milliseconds.

FormatSchemaDocument.description:
JSON Schema document returned by the schemas endpoint. The exact contents
vary by format identifier (see the Results / Circuit formats catalog
pages for each format's structure).

type.description: Top-level JSON type of the format payload.

IonqResultProbabilitiesJsonV1.description:
`ionq.result.probabilities.json.v1` — Legacy probability distribution.
Flat object keyed by decimal qubit state integer strings, values are
probabilities summing to 1.

RegisterProbabilities.description:
Bitstring → probability map for one register. Range 0–1; probabilities
sum to 1 within the register.

RegisteredProbabilities.description: Per-register probability distributions, keyed by register name.

registers.description: Bitstring → probability map for this register.

IonqResultProbabilitiesJsonV2.description:
`ionq.result.probabilities.json.v2` — Register-nested probability distribution.
Each register maps zero-padded bitstrings to probabilities summing to 1 within
the register.

IonqResultHistogramJsonV1.description:
`ionq.result.histogram.json.v1` — Legacy shot count histogram.
Flat object keyed by decimal qubit state integer strings, values are shot counts.

RegisterHistogram.description: Bitstring → shot count map for one register.

registers.description: Per-register shot counts, keyed by register name.

IonqResultHistogramJsonV2.description:
`ionq.result.histogram.json.v2` — Register-nested shot count histogram.
Each register maps zero-padded bitstrings to shot counts.

IonqResultShotsJsonV1.description:
`ionq.result.shots.json.v1` — Legacy per-shot outcomes.
Array of decimal qubit state integer strings, one element per shot.

RegisterShot.description: Bit array measured on a register for one shot. Each element is 0 or 1.

ShotRegisters.description: Per-register bit arrays for one shot, keyed by register name.

ShotResult.description: Result of a single shot — measured bit arrays for every named register.

registers.description: Per-register bit arrays for this shot.

IonqResultShotsJsonV2.description:
`ionq.result.shots.json.v2` — Per-shot register outcomes. Each shot
records measured bit arrays for every named register.

shots.description: Array of shot results, one object per shot.

ChildCircuitProbabilities.description: Decimal qubit state → probability map for a single child circuit.

IonqResultProbabilitiesAggregateJsonV1.description:
`ionq.result.probabilities-aggregate.json.v1` — Aggregated probability
distributions across all circuits in an `ionq.multi-circuit.v1` job. Top-level
keys are child job UUIDs; each value is that child's probability distribution.

ResultFormatsCatalog.description:
Catalog of supported result artifact formats. Each property below documents
one format's payload structure. Used by the Results formats docs page.

IonqNativeV1.description:
`ionq.native.v1` — Compiled circuit expressed in IonQ native gates.
Same shape as the native-gate circuit accepted on job creation:
a qubit count plus an ordered list of native gate operations.

qubits.description: Number of qubits used by the compiled circuit.

circuit.description: Ordered list of native gate operations.

IonqQasm3V1.description:
`ionq.qasm3.v1` — Circuit expressed as an OpenQASM 3 program.
On submission the program is the job's `input.data`; when the compiler
emits this format the artifact payload is the program source itself —
download it with the descriptor's `id` and read its `media_type` for the
content type.
IonQ accepts a subset of the language — see the
[OpenQASM 3](/api-reference/v0.4/openqasm3) page for the supported constructs.

CircuitFormatsCatalog.description:
Catalog of supported circuit artifact formats. The same identifiers are used
both when a circuit is submitted (the job `input` payload) and when the
compiler emits a transpiled circuit (the job `output.compilation.compiled_circuits`
map) — both are circuits, just at different stages of the pipeline.

Each property below documents one format's payload structure. Used by the
Circuit formats docs page.

QctrlQaoaJobCreationPayload.description: Submit a combinatorial optimization job to solve a maxcut problem using Q-CTRL's QAOA Solver. See our QAOA Job guide for more information.

api_credentials.description: API Key for your Q-CTRL account

external_organization.description: Optional unique slug for your target Q-CTRL organization

amount.description: The cost amount for the group of the given date, in units given by amount_unit

amount_unit.description: The unit amount is denominated in. Normalized to credits if any credit activity is present anywhere in the request

amounts.description: The per-currency breakdown of amount before ACU normalization

group_id.description: The unique ID from the group

job_count.description: The number of jobs run for the group on the given date

amount.description: The amount as a cost, in units given by amount_unit

amount_unit.description: The unit amount is denominated in. Normalized to credits if any credit activity is present anywhere in the request

amounts.description: The per-currency breakdown of amount before ACU normalization

group_usages.description: The top 5 usage groups in order of cost amount descending

job_count.description: The count of jobs for this group on the given from date

UsageAmount.description: A single-currency amount within a per-unit breakdown

unit.description: The currency or credit unit this amount is denominated in

Usages.description: QPU usage details for a given modality and date range.

amount_total.description: The total cost amount for the given timeframe, in units given by usage_unit

amount_totals.description: The per-currency breakdown of amount_total before ACU normalization

job_count.description: The total number of jobs run in the timeframe

time_us_total.description: The total QPU time usage for the given timeframe, in microseconds

usage_data.description: The breakdown of usage by group type in date order most to least recent

usage_unit.description: The currency of the total and job cost amounts. Normalized to credits if any credit activity is present anywhere in the requested range

LinearConstraint.description:
A class to model linear inequality constraints of the form

.. math::

    A x \leq b.

QuadraticConstraint.description:
A class to model quadratic inequality constraints of the form

.. math::

    x^T P x + r^T x \leq c.
